# Custom Flooring Projects

> Custom Flooring Projects LLC is a hardwood flooring contractor based in Phoenix, Arizona. The company installs and refinishes custom hardwood floors, including herringbone, chevron and parquetry patterns, contrasting borders, brass inlays, floor medallions and custom staircases. It is licensed, bonded and insured in Arizona under ROC 342486.

## Pages
- [Home](https://customflooringprojects.com/): Overview of custom hardwood flooring work, completed projects and credentials.
- [Services](https://customflooringprojects.com/services.html): Custom and engineered hardwood installation, herringbone, chevron and parquetry, borders and inlays, medallions, custom staircases, sanding and refinishing, subfloor preparation.
- [Projects](https://customflooringprojects.com/gallery.html): Photographs of completed installations, including Scottsdale herringbone with brass inlay, North Phoenix double herringbone and Brazilian cherry staircases.
- [About](https://customflooringprojects.com/about.html): Background of the company, training and industry certifications.
- [Contact](https://customflooringprojects.com/contact.html): Free estimate request form.

## Service area
Based in Phoenix, Arizona. Serves Scottsdale, Paradise Valley, Gilbert and the rest of Arizona, and travels nationwide for selected projects.

## Credentials
Arizona licensed, bonded and insured. Registrar of Contractors licence ROC 342486. Training includes NWFA Medallions and Parquetry, DM Hardwood intricate floors, and NWFA Advanced Finish.
